description: Regional WAF protects the private ALB with bounded rate limiting keyed to a CloudFront-authenticated viewer IP header

description_bdd.given: the accepted bootstrap-free AWS deployment topology
description_bdd.then: CloudFront overwrites a dedicated header from event.viewer.ip and regional WAF aggregates its positive-limit rate rule on that trusted header

source: ADR-0006 § Decision and Consequences + PRD.md § Deployment / AWS and Security posture
